env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided command discovery; the pinned Lake/Lean identities are recorded by the predecessor validation receipt

network_enforcement: The checker performs no network operation and runs the narrow Lean elaboration through the existing pinned Lake environment. The shared warm dependency cache is reused read-only, so the result is expressly nonrelease worker evidence.
scope_boundary: Reconciles all 24 frozen obligations and current authority, checks that the three theorem packages and exact root remain unproved, and runs the exact Statement.lean elaboration through the pinned environment. It does not accept the stale predecessor recipe, close any frozen proof obligation, supply H0 or R0, produce cold/offline or independent release evidence, establish AUDIT-Z or THEOREM-Z, release the theorem, or exercise master authority.
